title: puck/t1000_e ARM build broken: gnss_ag3335 modem_pipe API arity + native.c -Werror=switch-enum
description: Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-dzyt (uwip.3 validation, worker8/heft 2026-09-09). Building lichen/apps/puck for t1000_e/nrf52840 (full west module set, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set) fails on pre-existing errors unrelated to dzyt: (1) lichen/drivers/gnss/gnss_ag3335.c:197/205/213/225 'too few arguments to function modem_pipe_open/modem_pipe_close' — Zephyr 4.1 modem_pipe API gained an arg the driver doesn't pass; (2) gnss_ag3335.c:232 and lichen/lib/native/native.c:104 (7 sites) -Werror=switch-enum unhandled enumerators (PM_DEVICE_ACTION_TURN_ON/OFF; USB_DC_*). Neither file was touched by dzyt. Fix: add the missing modem_pipe argument per Zephyr 4.1 API and add the missing switch cases (or default) in both files.
close_reason: Fixed: (1) gnss_ag3335.c modem_pipe_open/close now pass the Zephyr 4.1 k_timeout_t arg (K_SECONDS(10), matching in-tree gnss_u_blox_m8/gnss_nmea_generic); (2) gnss_ag3335_pm_action and native.c lichen_usb_status_cb switches made exhaustive for -Wswitch-enum - pm_device_action names all 4 members (TURN_ON/OFF -> -ENOTSUP + trailing return), usb_dc_status_code names all 12 members (replacing default:; RESET/CONFIGURED wedge accounting unchanged). Verified on heft: built both objects for t1000_e/nrf52840 under the real ARM -Werror/-Wswitch-enum flags via ninja object targets -> ninja_exit=0, zero error:/switch-enum/arity diagnostics (the full west build stops earlier on PRE-EXISTING, unrelated breaks in lr1110.c and slip_transport.c on that base, out of scope for this bead). 3x delegated kimi-k3 reviews: all PASS. Finding filed: gnss_l76k.c has the identical two break classes -> project-LICHEN-worker6-ax5b (P2).
